content:
sara: Heads-up — seeing a burst of delivery-failed alerts from alertbridge, looks like webhook retries never stop :alarm_clock:
incident-bot: alertbridge: webhook delivery failed -> status=502, retry_count=5, route=notify-proxy-east

mike: Is this only hitting the notify-proxy-east path?
jane: Customers reported missed pages 2m ago, they didn't get a page or SMS. I'm on it.

tom: oncall-rotation-bot shows handoff executed 10:12 but oncall didn't receive a page. Could be outbound gateway.
sara: I see a pattern: retries incrementing but final delivery never succeeded. headers show Connection: keep-alive and then ECONNRESET.

incident-bot: recent attempts:
```
2024-06-06T10:12:31Z notify-proxy-east POST /webhook -> 502 Bad Gateway (upstream reset)
2024-06-06T10:12:36Z retry 1
2024-06-06T10:12:42Z retry 2
2024-06-06T10:12:48Z retry 3
```

mike: I'm switching our notify route to notify-proxy-west to see if that clears the backlog. Will also bump retry backoff.
jane: Can someone confirm manual paging option? Support needs to escalate for the impacted customer.
tom: Manual page sent to oncall via /ops page -- got ack from oncall (TomK) at 10:13.
sara: Thanks. Mike, please post the exact command you used so we can replicate in runbook.
mike: Ran: `/infra route-set notify default notify-proxy-west --force` then `incident-bot trigger resend --queue alertbridge`

incident-bot: resend task started, republishing 48 queued notifications to notify-proxy-west.
jane: Noted 3 customers affected: Acme, Zephyr, Bluefront — they all reported delayed pages. Support notified them with ETA.

sara: After switching, the error rate dropped quickly. New deliveries show 200 OK.

incident-bot: sample post-delivery log:
```
2024-06-06T10:13:05Z notify-proxy-west POST /webhook -> 200 OK (delivered) id=abc123
2024-06-06T10:13:06Z notify-proxy-west POST /sms -> 200 OK id=def456
```

tom: Looks like upstream edge pool in east was exhausted; west has spare capacity. Might be a transient spike.
mike: I'll roll a safe config change: reduce keep-alive idle to 30s and increase connection pool to the east proxies. Filing follow-up.
sara: Immediate mitigation done. Actions:
- mike: full proxy healthcheck + tune connection pool (owner)
- tom: confirm no other missed pages and follow manual escalations (owner)
- jane: customer comms + post-incident note (owner)

incident-bot: paging metrics normalized, suppression window cleared. No more retry storms observed in last 6m.
sara: We'll run an RCA tomorrow — suspected cause: edge proxy connection pool exhaustion + retry amplification. Marking this thread as the live mitigation log for the incident. :white_check_mark:
